_doc: Rule (f)'s scope (Lead 2026-10-15): the files a number in a comparison or a multiply is held to the numeric-baseline.json ratchet in. simRoots: the sim's entry files; check.ts follows their relative imports, so a file the sim starts to import joins the scope by itself. prefixes: whole folders in scope. format: files whose numbers are a wire or file format (byte markers, varints, version gates), exempt by name with the reason. Everything else is counted, report-only.

format.reason: the duel record's byte format: version gates, quantisation (q8 at 127), header and group lengths; the group size bound 2-7 at the RecordGroup check is a validation limit, flagged to Combat to move to a row
the world record's byte format: varint packing (128), byte and u32 ranges, the step flag bits, the header length cap
the record header's magic bytes (0x46 0x4b) and the version gates that step its byte offsets
